Trace, implement and test: leetcode561 array partition i hash simulation with stl array and bit operation

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int arrayPairSum(vector<int>& nums) {
        const int max_val = *max_element(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        const int min_val = *min_element(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        const int offset = -min_val;
        vector<int> countDict(max_val - min_val + 1);

        for (int num : nums)
            ++countDict[num + offset];

        int res = 0;
        int index = 0;
        int n = min_val;

        while (n <= max_val)
        {
            if (countDict[n + offset] == 0)
            {
                ++n;
                continue;
            }
            res += (++index & 1) ? n : 0;
            --countDict[n + offset];
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {6, 2, 6, 5, 1, 2};
    int res = sol.arrayPairSum(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
